## Benchmarking

See [`BENCHMARKS.md`](./BENCHMARKS.md) for historical results.

The benchmark data in this directory was collected using the legacy `ev-exec` and `ev-range-exec` SP1 programs, which have since been replaced by `ev-batch-exec`.

Please refer to [sp1/ev-batch-exec](../../crates/sp1/ev-batch-exec/README.md) for the current batch execution program.
